payload.body_you:
The creative project has enough supplies. It needs hours. Dating has enough chemistry. It needs follow-through. The child, hobby, or pleasure you care about needs a place in your actual week, not another promise that you will get back to it when life calms down. Saturn moving through your 5th house makes joy more serious because neglecting it has started to cost you.

Give the creative work a schedule. Make the date. Finish one piece before buying materials for the next one. But do not turn pleasure into another job description. Not every hobby needs a market. Not every date needs a five-year plan. Some joy should remain useful only because it makes you feel more alive.
